sentences.text: The chain starts with a lower 2026 ceiling for MBG, Rp268 trillion after a cut from Rp335 trillion, and runs on through 29,679 SPPG kitchens that were still cooking and still drawing on the budget at the end of May 2026.
One step in the middle holds on the record: Kompas puts MBG spending at Rp88.15 trillion through May 2026, and Antara carries the same figure from the finance minister.

The steps on either side of it are where the sources in this run stop, since none of them states that the reduced ceiling is what the programme has been spending against, and none carries the smaller envelope the remaining months have to run on.

Two things sit just outside the frame: the budget line that receives the fiscal room the cut freed, and the division nobody performs, how much of Rp268 trillion is already gone and how much the rest of the year has to work with.

The parties at the end of the money are counted nowhere in the chain: SPPG partners and the crews they pay, the farmers and suppliers whose income this spending is, the 63.13 million people reached through May 2026, and the kitchens and regions still waiting for a place in the programme.

On the scale panel, the Rp268 trillion ceiling and the Rp88.15 trillion already spent sit inside total state spending of Rp3,842.7 trillion, next to Rp599.44 trillion of debt interest and Rp210.06 trillion of energy subsidy in the same enacted 2026 budget.
Cerita ini berdiri di atas dua angka: pagu anggaran MBG 2026 yang dipangkas ke Rp268 triliun, dan belanja yang terserap Rp88,15 triliun hingga Mei 2026.
Sambungan yang punya sumber adalah bagian tengahnya, saat program tetap berjalan dengan 29.679 dapur SPPG per akhir Mei 2026 dan Kompas memuat serapan Rp88,15 triliun hingga Mei 2026.
Dua sambungan lain berhenti tanpa sumber: dari pagu yang dipangkas ke belanja yang sedang berjalan, dan dari angka kumulatif Mei ke sisa tahun yang berjalan dengan ruang belanja lebih kecil.

Panel skala menaruh keduanya, pagu Rp268 triliun dan belanja Rp88,15 triliun, di dalam total belanja negara APBN 2026 sebesar Rp3.842,7 triliun, berdampingan dengan bunga utang Rp599,44 triliun dan subsidi energi Rp210,06 triliun.

Alokasi program pada awal 2026 tercatat Rp335 triliun, sementara yang tidak pernah disandingkan artikel mana pun adalah porsi pagu baru yang sudah terpakai dan ruang yang tersisa untuk bulan-bulan sesudah Mei.
Di luar bingkai ada 1,28 juta pekerja dapur, 142.387 pemasok pangan, 63,13 juta orang penerima manfaat, antrean dapur yang belum terlayani, dan pos APBN yang menerima ruang fiskal hasil pemangkasan.

q.en: This chain has three steps. Which one does a source in this run actually state?
q.id: Dalam rangkaian artikel ini, langkah mana yang punya sumber yang menyatakannya?

options.en: That the programme kept running on 29,679 SPPG kitchens and its spending stood at Rp88.15 trillion through May 2026.
options.id: Bahwa program tetap berjalan dengan 29.679 dapur SPPG dan belanjanya tercatat Rp88,15 triliun hingga Mei 2026.

options.en: That the Rp268 trillion ceiling is what the programme has been spending against since the cut.
options.id: Bahwa pagu Rp268 triliun itulah acuan belanja program sejak pemangkasan.

options.en: That the rest of 2026 runs on a smaller spending envelope.
options.id: Bahwa sisa tahun 2026 berjalan dengan ruang belanja yang lebih kecil.

note.en: The claim map marks the middle step as the only one carrying a quotation: Kompas published "Anggaran MBG Terserap Rp 88,15 Triliun hingga Mei 2026", and Antara carries the same figure attributed to Finance Minister Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa. The steps to its left and its right have no source stating them yet.
note.id: Peta klaim menandai sambungan tengah sebagai satu-satunya yang punya kutipan: Kompas memuat "Anggaran MBG Terserap Rp 88,15 Triliun hingga Mei 2026", dan Antara memuat angka yang sama dengan atribusi kepada Menteri Keuangan Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa. Dua sambungan di kiri dan kanannya belum punya sumber yang menyatakannya.

q.en: Inside the articles themselves, what is the Rp88.15 trillion through May 2026 measured against?
q.id: Di dalam artikel-artikelnya sendiri, angka Rp88,15 triliun hingga Mei 2026 diukur terhadap apa?

options.en: Against total state spending of Rp3,842.7 trillion in the 2026 budget.
options.id: Terhadap total belanja negara APBN 2026 sebesar Rp3.842,7 triliun.

options.en: Against the MBG ceiling after the cut, Rp268 trillion, and the room left in it.
options.id: Terhadap pagu MBG setelah pemangkasan, Rp268 triliun, berikut sisa ruangnya.

options.en: Against nothing: the articles carry the cumulative figure on its own.
options.id: Tidak terhadap apa pun: artikelnya memuat angka kumulatifnya saja.

note.en: The Rp3,842.7 trillion denominator comes from the scale panel, not from the reporting. Inside the articles the May figure stands on its own, and the hidden element records the Rp268 trillion ceiling as the denominator nobody sets beside it, along with the room left for the months after May.
note.id: Pembagi sebesar Rp3.842,7 triliun itu datang dari panel skala, bukan dari artikelnya. Di dalam artikel, angka Mei berdiri sendiri; elemen tersembunyi mencatat pagu Rp268 triliun sebagai pembagi yang tidak pernah disandingkan, berikut ruang yang tersisa untuk bulan-bulan sesudahnya.

q.en: The rest of 2026 runs on a smaller envelope. Who does that reach before it reaches anyone at a ministry desk?
q.id: Sisa tahun 2026 berjalan dengan ruang belanja yang lebih kecil. Siapa yang lebih dulu merasakannya, sebelum siapa pun di meja kementerian?

options.en: Bondholders, since debt interest sits in the same budget.
options.id: Pemegang surat utang negara, karena bunga utang berada di APBN yang sama.

options.en: Kitchen partners billing per portion, their crews, and the suppliers they buy from.
options.id: Mitra dapur yang menagih per porsi, para pekerjanya, dan pemasok tempat mereka membeli bahan.

options.en: The auditors reconciling the May figure.
options.id: Auditor yang mencocokkan angka realisasi Mei.

note.en: The claim map keeps four groups outside the chain: SPPG partners and their crews on payment terms, upstream suppliers whose income this spending is, recipients for the remaining months, and the kitchens and regions still queued. They stand at the end of the money, which is where a change in the envelope arrives first. Debt interest appears on the scale panel as its own line, not as a claim on what MBG has left.
note.id: Peta klaim menaruh empat pihak di luar rangkaiannya: mitra dapur SPPG dan pekerjanya yang menunggu termin pembayaran, pemasok hulu yang menerima belanja itu sebagai pendapatan, penerima manfaat untuk bulan-bulan sesudahnya, serta dapur dan daerah yang masih mengantre. Mereka berdiri di ujung aliran uangnya, dan di situlah perubahan ruang belanja tiba lebih dulu. Bunga utang muncul di panel skala sebagai pos tersendiri, bukan sebagai tagihan atas sisa anggaran MBG.

prompt.en: Before you open the panels: a budget line gets cut, and the story reports how much of it has been spent. Which side of that goes missing?
prompt.id: Sebelum panelnya terbuka: sebuah pos anggaran dipangkas, lalu beritanya memuat berapa yang sudah dibelanjakan. Sisi mana dari cerita itu yang tidak ikut dimuat?

options.en: The budget line that receives the room the cut freed up.
options.id: Pos APBN yang menerima ruang fiskal hasil pemangkasan.

options.en: The ceiling the spending figure is measured against, and what remains of it.
options.id: Pagu yang menjadi acuan angka belanja itu, dan sisa yang masih ada di dalamnya.

options.en: The kitchen partners, crews and suppliers who bill against what remains.
options.id: Mitra dapur, para pekerjanya, dan pemasok yang menagih dari sisa itu.

options.en: The recipients for the rest of the year, and the households behind them.
options.id: Penerima manfaat untuk sisa tahun, dan rumah tangga di belakang mereka.

editorial_notes: Reconciliation, base selection per move: mechanism and denominator take the Indonesian authoring as base, because those questions ask what a source states and what the articles themselves measure against, and their notes carry the quotation that settles them. Incidence takes the English authoring as base, because its two distractors are anchored to the scale panel the reader has just met. In each case the non-base locale was written natively rather than translated, with option order and correct index held identical across the pair.

Reconciliation, el universe: slots/mbg-cut/A9.input.json is not on disk in run-2026-07-29, and the panels JSON supplied to this reconciler was truncated, so the el universe used here is the union of the two authorings' bindings, both drawn from the full panels input. Nothing outside that union is bound and no el_id was invented. If the shipping panels carry a family marker panel, its el_id still needs a sentence in both locales before the fidelity gate.

Reconciliation, English bindings: three el_ids were added to the English narration so every figure rides an element bound in the same sentence, matching what the Indonesian authoring did with the same elements. v-1 gains mbg-cut.scale.chip.sppg-kitchens for the 29,679 kitchens, v-4 gains mbg-cut.scale.seg.mbg-ceiling-after-cut for the Rp268 trillion it names, and v-5 gains mbg-cut.scale.chip.beneficiaries for the 63.13 million reached through May 2026. No sentence text was changed in either locale, and the Indonesian bundle is carried verbatim.
Panel coverage after merge: mbg-cut.panel.claim_map is carried by v-1 in both locales; mbg-cut.panel.scale_check is carried by v-6 in English and by v-4 in Indonesian.

Mechanism, correct index 0: mbg-cut.edge.n2-n3 is the only edge in the graph carrying status supported, quoted from Kompas and corroborated by Antara with attribution to the Finance Minister. Options 1 and 2 map exactly onto mbg-cut.edge.n1-n2 and mbg-cut.edge.n3-n4, both status missing. Those two are the steps a reader most naturally assumes are on the record, which is why they are the distractors worth offering.

Denominator, correct index 2: the Rp3.842,7 triliun figure is supplied by the scale_check panel, not by any article in the family, and mbg-cut.hidden.ceiling-denominator is the element recording that no article puts the Rp268 triliun ceiling beside the Rp88,15 triliun drawdown. Option 0 is the trap a reader can see afterwards: they have just met that denominator on the scale panel and can carry it back into the reporting.

Incidence, correct index 1: mbg-cut.hidden.sppg-payment-terms and mbg-cut.hidden.upstream-suppliers are the two out-of-frame elements that bill against the remaining envelope. Because the English authoring won the base for this move, the two distractors are the bondholder and the auditor rather than the ministry and the commentator. Option 0 is the adjacent line the reader has just met on the scale panel, debt interest, which sits in the same budget without being a claim on what MBG has left. Option 2 names reconciliation, which arrives after the money rather than ahead of it.

Reviewer flag: the Indonesian narration v-6 emits 1,28 juta pekerja and 142.387 pemasok, and both figures carry a self_reported flag on their elements. The Indonesian authoring disclosed that inside its own incidence note; the merged incidence answer no longer restates it in words, since the English authoring supplied that move. Confirm the panel labels carry the provenance where the reader meets the two figures.

No arithmetic anywhere. The share of the reduced ceiling already spent, and what remains after the May drawdown, are named in the Indonesian v-5 and the English v-4 as quantities nobody published, and are never computed, because mbg-cut.hidden.ceiling-denominator is precisely the element recording that the two figures are never placed side by side. Every figure emitted is the display string of an element bound in the same sentence, in the number format of its own locale.

Lexicon forcing: the ordinary Indonesian for 'one of the steps' is unusable under the whole-word lint, so the Indonesian v-3 counts them instead, 'Dua sambungan lain'. Edge status is carried as 'punya sumber' against 'berhenti tanpa sumber', and the English mirrors it as a source stating a step against no source stating it, which conveys supported against missing with no verdict word in either direction.

The Indonesian v-2 says 'Kompas memuat' and the English v-2 says 'Kompas puts', rather than any verb implying confirmation. A supported edge means a source states the step, not that the step holds, and both locales keep that distinction visible.

Sentence order in both locales follows the order the reader meets the artifact: what the claim rests on, the step that has a source, the steps that stop, the parties outside the frame, and the scale the figures sit inside. The two locales reach those points by different routes, which is why the Indonesian reaches the scale panel at v-4 and the English at v-6.

Stayed unsaid: the destination of the freed fiscal room. Both locales name it as an open budget line and stop there. No candidate recipient is suggested, because mbg-cut.hidden.cut-destination records that no source in this family names one.

Stayed unsaid: serving days, portion standards and coverage for the remaining months are folded into the recipients and the queue rather than spelled out as outcomes. Every sentence stays retrospective, and none states what happens next.

Prediction tap: the English prompt won the base because it names the mechanism, a budget line cut against a spending figure reported, instead of asking generically what was left out; the Indonesian was then written natively around 'sebuah pos anggaran' to clear the whole-word lint. All four options are genuine hidden elements, so none is a giveaway and none is a decoy the reveal contradicts. What the reveal returns is the count of how many of them the coverage left out, not a correction of the reader.

Shape: this is the merged bilingual slot output. narration carries both bundles, and every L10n object in sparring and the prediction tap carries en and id together, for the A9.json the runner reads whole.

Family panel binding, added after authoring: the runner appends the family marker panel with el_id mbg-cut-p-family to panels[], and the family strip it renders from the root family block needs a binding in both locales before the fidelity gate, which is the open item the el universe note above flagged. Nothing else changed: no sentence text, no sentence added, six sentences per locale, only two el_id additions. English v-2 takes it because its own words name two members of the strip, Kompas and Antara, and say they carry the same figure, which is what the reader meets when the strip puts the sibling articles side by side. Indonesian v-5 takes it because its own words range over the whole family, 'yang tidak pernah disandingkan artikel mana pun', and the strip is the article list that phrase quantifies over; that scope word had no element carrying it before, so the rebind also closes a trace gap rather than opening one. The two locales reach the family by different routes, outlets carrying the same figure in English and absence across every article in Indonesian, and they do not disagree about a fact.
